CN: ·虔诚而尊贵的提灯圣子，纯洁的圣心永远追逐光明。\n·运用圣辉之力周期性强化卡牌效果，运用圣子的权能裁决一切漆黑的罪恶。\n·本次关卡中，将携带等级 50 级，技能等级5，启灵3的波吕克斯出战，每回合获得 50 狂气和 1 张「灵感」。
EN: A pious and noble Divus of the Lightbearers, his Sacred Heart perpetually yearns for the dawn. He harnesses divine brilliance to periodically enhance card effects and wields the authority of a Divus to pass judgment upon all sins that dwell in shadow.\nIn this stage, Pollux debuts at Lvl. 50 with Skill Lvl. 5 and Enlightenment 3, gaining 50 Aliemus and 1 "Insight" each turn.

CN:
他是畸生而出的血肉，由剖开又缝补的肌肤、空洞的胸腔、污浊的心脏与无形的锁链构成。
他被捧上高台，人们膜拜在他的脚下，声称他拥有无垢的灵魂。
他究竟是什么？他在无数梦中茫然发问，那暗绿的湖水与空无一物的浓雾中，只有他的声音孤独回响。
EN:
He is flesh born from a twisted existence, made up of cut and resewn skin, an empty chest cavity, a tainted heart, and invisible chains.
He is placed on a pedestal; people worship at his feet and claim he possesses a pure soul.

What exactly is he? Lost in countless dreams, he asks in confusion; among the dark green lake water and the empty fog, only his voice echoes in loneliness.

CN:
基于对波吕克斯那颗「圣心」与提灯教会的降神仪式之间可能存在的关系的考量，弥萨格曾组建了研究小组对「圣心」进行了一系列检查与实验。
令波吕克斯遗憾的是，这颗「圣心」已经完全替代了他原本心脏的机能，融入了他的身体之中，无法直接摘除或替换。
在观察实验中，研究人员发现这颗外形酷似眼瞳的「圣心」时常会产生非波吕克斯意志下的轻微抖动与转动，如同一只真正的眼睛。
但经过光源测试后，证明「圣心」不存在类似视力的功能，这种活动更像是源于对其他生物或物品的感应。
在不同放置物品的对照中，与融蚀、银芯相关物品的靠近更容易引起「圣心」的活动，在被融蚀生物与唤醒体面前，「圣心」的活动则尤为明显。
在波吕克斯主动使用「圣心」的力量后，普通物品的物理及化学性质不会有任何改变，而在融蚀物品、生物面前，则出现了速度惊人的融蚀扩大现象。原本位于融蚀阶段早期的动植物肉眼可见地加速度过了发展阶段，快速转向融蚀末期的状态。当动植物原本受到的融蚀越严重，这样的扩散则越迅速。
在建立了严格保护措施的唤醒体实验中，当面对「圣心」的力量时，唤醒体表示感受到有某种黑暗逼近的危险气息，实验因而被迅速叫停。波吕克斯也在校方的严正说明下，保证不会将圣心的力量对唤醒体使用。
由于波吕克斯极其配合的态度和良好的自控力，弥萨格并未给波吕克斯佩戴强制管制道具，只是定期给波吕克斯安排了体检与力量使用训练。
据说在听闻了实验结果后，唤醒体温柯尔曾尖叫着险些晕倒，并在自己的实验室和宿舍门上张贴了禁止波吕克斯靠近的告示，校方屡次劝说无果，波吕克斯本人对此则大度地表示会尊重温柯尔的要求。
EN:
Considering the potential relationship between Pollux's "Sacred Heart" and the Church of the Lightbearers' divine ritual, Mythag formed a research team to conduct a series of inspections and experiments on the heart.
To Pollux's dismay, the "Sacred Heart" had entirely replaced his original heart's function, becoming integrated into his body, making direct removal or replacement impossible.
During observational experiments, researchers discovered that the "Sacred Heart," which resembles a pupil, often exhibited subtle tremors and rotations independent of Pollux's will, much like a real eye.
However, light source testing proved the "Sacred Heart" did not possess visual functions. Instead, the activity appeared to be sensitivity to other living beings or objects. In comparative trials with various items, proximity to items related to Dissolution and the Silver Core triggered the heart's activity more easily.
Its activity was particularly pronounced near Dissoluted creatures and Awakeners. When Pollux actively used the "Sacred Heart's" power, the physical and chemical properties of ordinary items remained unchanged. However, when directed at Dissoluted items and creatures, a remarkable expansion of Dissolution occurred. Living organisms visibly in the early stages of Dissolution rapidly accelerated towards the late stages. The more severe the Dissolution originally suffered by the organisms, the faster this spread occurred.
In experiments with strict protective measures on Awakeners, the subjects reported a sense of approaching darkness and danger when faced with the "Sacred Heart's" power, prompting the experiment to be quickly halted.
After a stern explanation from the school, Pollux promised not to use the power against Awakeners. Due to Pollux's cooperation and excellent self-control, Mythag did not impose mandatory controlling items on him, but instead arranged regular health checks and power training.
Apparently, after hearing of the experimental results, Awakener Winkle almost fainted from screaming before posted notices prohibiting Pollux from approaching on the doors of her laboratory and dormitory. The school repeatedly tried to persuade her to no avail, and Pollux graciously stated that he would respect Winkle's wishes.

CN:
比起卡斯托尔那样积极好学的态度，波吕克斯接触外界的风格则更加谨慎。
观察、思考、怀疑，足够的思虑与小心让曾经的他能够在教会的重重控制下，带着卡斯托尔成功出逃。
从儿时起，他便学会了揣度他人的想法，学会了撒谎，学会了用笑容遮掩真实的想法。哪怕是在亲密无间的哥哥面前，他仍会下意识地用轻松的笑容去安抚对方。
「没关系的。」
「一定可以的。」
在那样庞然大物的手掌之下，弱小者需要拼尽全力才能寻到一丝可能的希望。
经历了漫长的遗忘与欺骗后，如今的他更加不允许任何危险与失误的存在。哪怕听从泰旖丝的建议来到弥萨格后，在很长的一段时间里，他都保持了相当的警惕。
在其他唤醒体看来，波吕克斯是一个话不多，却很有耐心，常常会对人露出微笑的友善家伙。但那些久经世故的年长者看到他后，则都纷纷感叹两兄弟之间的不同。
据泰旖丝说，哪怕是在她的面前，波吕克斯也会有意无意地将卡斯托尔挡在身后——从他找回记忆以来，他已经不再愿意让卡斯托尔总是保护着他。
詹金也曾煞有介事地向守密人告状波吕克斯的表里不一，声称自己不小心捡到卡斯托尔的东西时，曾看到波吕克斯骤然阴沉的面孔。「那个家伙平时的好脾气肯定都是装的！他私下里就是那种会吃小孩的变态！」
然而在直面了守密人的力量后，波吕克斯对待守密人的态度就发生了一百八十度的转变，在「圣心」的剧烈反应下，他声称已从那伟大的灵魂中获悉了世界的真相，并毕恭毕敬地将守密人奉为了新的信仰。
EN:
Compared to Castor's eager and studious attitude, Pollux's approach to the world is one of quiet vigilance.
He observes, he thinks, he doubts. It was his meticulous consideration and caution that once enabled their successful escape from the church's heavy control. From a young age, he learned to gauge the intentions of others, to lie, and to hide his true thoughts behind a disarming smile. Even with his intimately close brother, he would subconsciously use a relaxed demeanor to soothe and reassure.
"It's okay."
"It will be alright."
Beneath the shadow of a giant, the weak must exhaust every means to grasp a single glimmer of hope.
Having endured a long period of forced amnesia and deception, he is now more intolerable of danger or mistakes. Even after heeding Thais's advice and coming to Mythag, he remained profoundly vigilant for a long time.
To other awakeners, Pollux appears as a quiet, patient, and friendly individual who often offers a gentle smile. But seasoned elders who see him can only sigh at the profound difference between the two brothers.
According to Thais, even in her presence, Pollux will intentionally or unintentionally position himself between her and Castor—since reclaiming his memory, he no longer wishes for Castor to always be his protector.
Jenkin once earnestly complained to the Keeper about Pollux's duality, claiming that when she "accidentally" picked up an item belonging to Castor, she witnessed his expression turn terrifying in an instant. "His usual good temper must be fake! He's the type who would eat children in private!"
However, after witnessing the Keeper's true power, Pollux's attitude underwent a complete transformation. He claims to have learned the truth of the world from that great soul and has now taken the Keeper as his new, unwavering faith.

CN:
在命运之神最初的设想里，他大概不应诞生于世。
一开始从人造双子实验中诞生的只有卡斯托尔一人，就在这团无知无觉的胚胎要被处理丢弃时，波吕克斯挣扎着，从哥哥的血肉中扭曲撕裂而生。他吸食了他的生命，也拯救了他的生命，他们的血肉、灵魂与命运就此交缠。
于枯燥的教会修行之中，两人的生活与命运原本别无二致，直到「神圣改造」仪式的开始，痛苦且无情的折磨让波吕克斯从圣子的宿命中惊醒。两个孩子做出了一生中最大胆的壮举，他们拿着一本过时的书籍描摹出了一副世界的地图，然后从一个虚假的世界中逃向了另一个幻想中的世界。
脆弱而短暂的美梦破碎后，残酷的惩罚未曾击垮他们的灵魂，但那宿命的残酷分叉已经将他们就此分隔了。
于丽埃特下令将两人分开供养，罪潭中的卡斯托尔不知道的是，两人想象中的酷刑并没有实施在波吕克斯身上，于丽埃特几近仁慈地结束了剩余的惩罚，甚至很快将波吕克斯从禁闭的暗室中放出，转而投入了密集严苛的神学教导。
波吕克斯满腹的不屈与疑惑在面对于丽埃特绝对从容的目光时，变成了某种不安与恐惧，她一定是掌握了某种他无力反抗的办法，才会如此好整以暇。
他挣扎、伪装、从未放弃。他好像做了许多事……但他做了什么呢？镜子中只剩下一个陌生的灵魂，忠诚地戴上了那顶圣子的冠冕。
他与他们的记忆，已经被彻底遗忘了。
EN:
In the original design of the God of Fate, Pollux was probably never meant to be born.
Initially, only Castor had been successfully created in the artificial Twin Divi experiment. Just as this single, clueless embryo was to be disposed of, Pollux struggled and twisted himself free from his brother's flesh. He absorbed his life force, yet in doing so, he also saved it—from that moment on, their flesh, souls, and fates were irrevocably intertwined.
In the monotonous routine of the church's teaching, their lives and destinies were identical. But with the start of the "Holy Transformation" ritual, the pain and ruthless torment awakened something within Pollux—a defiance of his ordained fate as a Divus. The two children committed the boldest act of their lives: they sketched a world map from an outdated book and escaped from one false world to another imagined one.
After that fragile, fleeting beautiful dream shattered, the cruel punishment that followed did not crush their souls, yet that merciless fork in fate had already driven them apart.
Juliette ordered the two to be separated and "re-educated." Castor, submerged in the pool of sin, remained unaware that the tortures they had imagined were never inflicted upon Pollux. Instead, with a decision nearing mercy, Juliette ended the physical punishment and soon released Pollux from the dark room's confinement, steering him instead toward intense and rigorous theological education.
Pollux's unyielding doubts transformed into a deep-seated unease and fear under Juliette's utterly calm gaze; she must have mastered a method of control he could not resist, to appear so completely at ease.
He struggled, he disguised himself, and he never gave up. It seemed he did so many things... but what, in the end, had he truly accomplished? In the mirror, only the soul of a stranger remained, dutifully wearing the crown of the Divus.
He, and all their shared memories, had been completely forgotten.

CN:
他的一生都活在被操纵的丝线下，那早早写好的剧本是一场可笑的谎言，令他不停失去、遗忘、错过。
在年少时他最渴望的是能够自由地挥舞翅膀，飞到那片湖水之外的世界去看看。
直到他为这个愿望失去了一切后，他已无法将那样轻盈的、无忧无虑的生活当做全部的梦想。
无尽的怒火将那颗漆黑的心脏点燃，他郁结成血的痛苦与仇恨，要用那些伪信者的死亡才能洗刷偿还。
EN:
His entire life was lived under manipulating strings; that script written long ago was a laughable lie that forced him to constantly lose, forget, and miss out.
When he was young, what he desired most was to freely flap his wings and see the world beyond that lake.
It wasn't until he lost everything to fulfill this wish that he could no longer regard such a light and carefree life as his ultimate dream.
Endless rage ignited that pitch-black heart, and the pain and hatred he repressed into his blood needed to be washed away with the deaths of those false believers.

CN: 您的赐予，我会心怀感激地使用。
EN: Your bestowed gift I shall wield, with the deepest gratitude.

CN: 过往的种种罪孽已然犯下，不应该再去逃避它。我还要去修正提灯的错误，将那些歧路之人引向正途。让我承担我的罪孽吧。然后，我将回应这道光、回应您的召唤，踏上那条真正的、属于圣子的道路。
EN: The sins of the past have been committed; I shall flee them no longer. I must also correct the Lantern's mistakes and guide the strayed back to the true path. Let me bear my sins. Then, I shall answer the light of your call and tread the right path as the Divus.

CN: 一位光明的侍从失去了他手中的灯火，这盲目的痛苦实在令我心焦，我衷心地恳请您将这个迷失的灵魂拯救，请您握住我的手，贴近这颗圣心，请您赐予我，通往光明的指引……
EN: I have lost my light, and this blind suffering torments me. I beg you, save my lost soul. Please, take my hand as I guide yours over this Holy Heart in my chest. Please, guide me toward the light...

CN: 引领我、给予我光明之人啊，曾经我一直被蒙蔽在虚假的意义中，现在在您的指引下，我已找回了我真正的使命——将那些愚昧而扭曲的伪信者矫邪归正，为世间带来恒久不灭的光明。我知晓您的无私，您并不需要我的虔诚与供奉，那么就请允许我跟随在您的身边，记录下您的每一条圣言与圣行，以供于暗夜之中指引我的前路。
EN: You have lead me and granted me Light. For so long I was blinded by false purpose. Now, I have found my true calling: to correct the ignorant and distorted heretics and bring everlasting Light to this world. I know of your selflessness; You have no need for my devotion or offerings. Then I beg of this: allow me to walk at your side, to record every sacred word and deed, that they may guide my path through the darkness.

CN: 您……您有什么旨意要传达于我吗？您的使徒随时准备聆听您的教诲。
EN: Do... do you have an order for me, my Light? Your Apostle stands ever-ready to hear your teaching.

CN: 银钥闪烁，你控制着脑海中那缕不可见的细密银丝，从闪亮的光点之中抽离。
EN: The Silver Key glints. You guide the invisible, delicate silver thread in your mind, withdrawing it from the shining dot of light.

CN: 奥吉尔单膝跪地，失去链接的维系，他不得不用长枪支撑身体，才不至于彻底倒下。
EN: Ogier sinks to one knee. With the link severed, he must brace himself with his spear to keep from collapsing entirely.

CN: 眼角、唇边、耳孔都溢出了浓黑的液体，器官都已经被不定形的漆黑软泥打碎，可想而知少年正承受着怎样的痛苦。
EN: Thick, black liquid seeps from the corners of his eyes, lips, and ears. His organs are already shattered by amorphous black slime—it's easy to imagine the agony the boy is enduring.

CN: 眼见奥吉尔距离失控越来越近，你选择不再等待，猛地握住了他已经覆满黑泥的双手。
EN: Seeing Ogier teetering closer towards losing control, you decide to wait no longer. You firmly grasp his hands, which now covered in black sludge.

CN: 计时器走了仅仅半圈，在断开链接的情况下，奥吉尔并没能坚持得比上一次训练更久。
EN: The stopwatch's hand barely passed half of the circle. Without the link, Ogier couldn't hold out any longer than in the previous training session.

CN: 他对授钥仪式那日的异动耿耿于怀，害怕自己有一日也会不受控制，将长枪指向你们——为此，他想要提升自己在无链接状态下维持理智的能力。
EN: He's been brooding over the anomaly from the day of the Keybestowal Ceremony, fearing that one day he might also lose control and turn his spear against you all. To that end, he wants to enhance his ability to maintain sanity without the link.

CN: 我们已经练了很久了，疲劳训练会适得其反的。
EN: We've trained long enough. Training with fatigue will backfire.

CN: 是我没有考虑周全……
EN: I didn't think that through...

CN: 明天我也没有调查任务，午餐后，不见不散。
EN: I don't have missions tomorrow either. See you after lunch, same place.

CN: 顶着幼犬兴奋雀跃的目光，你拖着同样疲惫的身躯回到了宿舍。
EN: Under his exuberant, puppy-like gaze, you drag your equally exhausted body back to the dormitory.

CN: 黑暗中响起陌生的悠扬乐曲，伴着阵阵银杯相击的声音，熙攘而典雅的氛围充斥着梦境。
EN: A strange, melodious tune rings out in the darkness, accompanied by the clinking of silver goblets. The dream is brimming with a bustling yet elegant atmosphere.

CN: 手探进了一片迷雾中，抓住了一片盛满未知的积雨云，触感真实而虚幻。
EN: Your hand plunges into a sea of mist, grasping what feels like a rain cloud—a touch both real and illusory.

CN: 还有被她们簇拥着，斜斜躺在软塌上的少女。
EN: And there, surrounded by them all, is a young girl reclining on a plush chaise.

CN: 无伤大雅，别太苛责%heorshe%。为了给各位呈现一场完美的宴会，我的侍官可是忙得一夜都没歇脚。
EN: It's no matter, don't be too harsh on {Male=him,Female=her}. My attendant has been busy without rest all night to present a perfect banquet for everyone.

CN: 身体的本能让你向她行了个礼。在或艳羡或鄙夷的目光中，你穿过贵妇的集群，向更多人聚集的大厅走去。
EN: Your body bows instinctively. Amidst gazes of both envy and disdain, you weave through the cluster of noblewomen toward the more crowded part of the hall.

CN: 你低头看着“自己”的手，肤色比你常年藏在手套下的皮肤要深上几分，处处都留着细微的淡痕，显然不是养尊处优之人。
EN: You look down at "your" hands. The skin tone is a few shades darker than your own, which are usually hidden under gloves. Fine, faint scar marks are littered across—clearly not the hands of someone raised in luxury.

CN: 路过的华贵金属花瓶更是印证了不详的猜想——
EN: The ornate gilded vase that you pass on the way further confirms your suspicion—

CN: 那上面映出的倒影，并不是你的脸。
EN: The reflection it presents is not your face.

CN: 侍官阁下！您是代表公主来的吗？
EN: {Male=Sir,Female=Miss}! You've come on behalf of the princess?

CN: 从人群中窜出来的侍女，显然比你更加目光如炬，一眼就从嘈杂纷繁的人群中找到了熟悉的“你”。
EN: A maid darts out from the crowd, her eyes clearly sharper than your own; she spots the familiar "you" instantly amidst the bustling throng.

CN: <Small:这么个小孩，要练多久才能成为真正的骑士啊……大公应该只是开玩笑的吧？>
EN: <Small:How long will it take for a kid like this to become a real knight... The Grand Duke must just be joking, right?>

CN: 这是你们之间的秘密，它将烙印在灵魂上，伴随永世。
EN: This is a secret between the two of you, etched into your souls and carried through eternity.

CN: 在第三次尝试醒来，却只是让眼前光景无端变化了一番后，你终于接受了被困在了奥吉尔记忆中的事实。
EN: After your third attempt to wake up only to see no changes in the scene before you, you finally accept the truth: you are trapped in Ogier's memories.

CN: 你站在公主寝殿一角，装出一副聆听者的模样，乖顺地扮演着侍官的角色。
EN: You stand in a corner of the princess's chamber, holding the appearance of a dutiful listener and meekly playing the role of an attendant.

CN: 他竟把父亲的话当了真…他那么年幼，怎么受得了骑士团的训练？
EN: He actually took Father's words seriously... He's just a kid, how can he possibly endure their training?

CN: 不…不对……也许还有其他可能性。
EN: No... that's not right... Perhaps there are other possibilities.

CN: 听侍女的描述，奥吉尔正在骑士团接受训练。既然奥吉尔未曾参与这段对话，那么这里是“奥吉尔记忆”的猜想就无法成立了。
EN: Based on the maid's account, Ogier is currently undergoing training at the Knights' Order. Since Ogier did not participate in this conversation, the hypothesis that this is "Ogier's memory" doesn't hold.

CN: 这并不是单纯的“记忆”。或许，你进入的是一段真实发生过的历史，或许，是一段被潜意识补完的梦境？
EN: This isn't merely a "memory." Perhaps you've entered a real, historical event, or maybe it's a dream based on someone's subconscious?

CN: 原来你还知道疼！我们叫了半天，你像尸体一样一点反应都没有，耳朵是不是出问题了？
EN: So you know it hurts! We've been calling you for ages, and you just stood there like a statue. Is there something wrong with your ears?

CN: 你最近总是走神，是太累了吧，要不要回家族封地休息一阵子？正好你们已经很久没有过假期了。
EN: You've been spacing out a lot lately. Are you too tired? Would you like to return to your family estate to rest for a while? It's been a long time since you last had a vacation.

CN: 脱离“梦境”的关键肯定在奥吉尔身上，尽管很好奇远离梦境中心的世界会是什么模样，但这个节骨眼，你不能离开太远。
EN: The key to escaping the "Dream" must lie with Ogier. Though you are curious about what the world beyond the center of the dream is like, you couldn't stray too far right now.

CN: 心事？是什么是什么？是不是有喜欢的人了在为此烦恼？
EN: Things on your mind? What is it? Is it that you've fallen for someone and are troubled by it?

CN: 是不是在心烦对方不喜欢你？公主——为我们的侍官阁下占卜一次吧，要不干脆送%heorshe%一剂爱情魔药——
EN: Are you worried the other person doesn't like you back? Your Highness, why don't you do a little divination for our dear attendant? Or better yet, just give {Male=him,Female=her} a love potion—

CN: 瞌睡时公主送来了枕头，给了你名正言顺的理由接近奥吉尔。
EN: Perfect timing—the princess provided you a perfect reason to approach Ogier.

CN: 不过如果实在需要魔药的话，还是能来找我要的哦。
EN: But if you do happen to need a potion, you can still come to me for it.

CN: 兵刃相接的脆响与其他人的叫好声连绵不绝，显然正有人顶着烈日进行对练。
EN: The crisp clang of blades mixed with cheers and jeers rolls across the field like thunder—people are sparring under the scorching sun.

CN: ——只是你没有想到，对练的其中一方，正是奥吉尔。
EN: You do not expect, however, for one of the sparring parties to be Ogier.

CN: 在绝对的力量悬殊面前，坚持与信念起不到什么作用。成年骑士尚未使出全力，金属共振就让奥吉尔的虎口脱了力。
EN: In the face of absolute disparity in strength, persistence and determination mean little. The adult knight hasn't even used his full strength, yet the shock of clashing weapons has already caused Ogier to lose the grip in his hands.

CN:
就是啊，你还太小啦。
过两年再来训练吧，你现在连武器都拿不起来。
EN: Yeah, you're still too young.\nCome back for training in a couple of years. You can barely lift a weapon right now.

CN: 奥吉尔浑身颤抖着，弯腰捡起掉落的长枪，吃力地调整准备姿势，将枪尖对准了对练骑士，
EN: Ogier trembles all over as he bends down to pick up the fallen spear. With great effort, he adjusts his stance, pointing the spear tip at the opposing knight.

CN: 少年的脸因疲惫和缺氧涨得通红，面对这样顽强的意志，本想用训练让奥吉尔知难而退的人才终于发话。
EN: The boy's face flushes red from exhaustion and lack of oxygen. Seeing his tenacious will, the Commander who intended to force Ogier to give up through training finally speaks.

CN: 您同意我加入骑士团了吗？！
EN: You agree to let me join the Knights' Order?!

CN: 团长话音未落，借着难得的轻快氛围，人群中冒出了小小的反抗，年轻的骑士们通过这种方式释放着压力。
EN: Before the Commander's words even fade, cheeky protest bubbles up from the crowd—the young knights blowing off steam in this light-hearted atmosphere.

CN: 这是公主亲自调配的药物，应该是做过特殊处理的吧。
EN: It's a special formulation from the Princess herself. It must have been specially treated.

CN: 公主的药？！太珍贵了，这怎么能给我用——嘶！
EN: Her Highness's potion?! This is too precious, how can I use it—Ouch!

CN:
别乱动，想浪费公主的仁慈吗。
你先坐下，让我处理完伤口。
EN: Hold still. Do you want to waste her kindness?\nSit down, let me treat your wounds.

CN:
生怕浪费了珍贵的药物，奥吉尔终于安分地坐了下来。
骑士团其他人也陆续离开了场地，这是难得的好时机。
EN: Afraid of squandering such a rare remedy, Ogier finally sits down quietly.\nThe other knights gradually leave the field, and you realize this is your chance.

CN: 受觐见，被选中，再得到骑士们的承认……真的好像做梦。
EN: Receiving summons, being chosen, earning the knights' respect... It truly feels like a dream.

CN:
父亲万一去世了，庄园里的人都会被遣散。
大家都还生着病…根本无处可去。
EN: If my father were to pass away, everyone in the manor would be dismissed.\nBut they're still sick... with nowhere else to go.

CN:
相似的青涩，如出一辙的坚韧意志。
他就是你认知中的奥吉尔，毫无疑问。
EN: The same youthful innocence, the same resilient will.\nHe is undoubtedly the Ogier you know.

CN:
好啦，我不会把这些事告诉公主的。
别太着急，眼泪都要掉下来了。
EN: Alright, alright, I won't tell the princess anything.\nDon't be so worried; your tears are about to fall.

CN: 梦境不会永远美满，正如美妙的歌谣不会永远奏响。
EN: Dreams are not sweet forever, just as beautiful melodies do not play forever.

CN: 梦境不会永远美满，正如美妙的歌谣不会永远奏响。
EN: Dreams are not sweet forever, just as beautiful melodies do not play forever.

CN: 梦境不会永远美满，正如美妙的歌谣不会永远奏响。
EN: Dreams are not sweet forever, just as beautiful melodies do not play forever.

CN: “梦境”
EN: In the "Dream"

CN:
就让奥吉尔一起来守卫行宫吧。
他可是名正言顺、大公钦定的守护骑士，不是吗？
EN: Let Ogier stay to guard the palace.\nHe is, after all, a legitimate Guardian Knight appointed by the Grand Duke, isn't he?

CN: 瘟疫在公国无序传播，王公贵族也未能幸免。公主在战争开始前就染了病，时至今日，她连离开床榻的力气都没有了。
EN: The plague spread unchecked through the Duchy, sparing not even the nobility. The princess fell ill before the war began, and now, she lacks even the strength to leave her bed.

CN: 宫廷医生更是直言，公主已经无法承受搬离行宫的奔波，轻微的颠簸都可能让她失去生命。
EN: The court physician declared her too frail to be moved from the palace—even the slightest jolt could take her life.

CN:
无论您怎么说，我都不会离开这里。请允许我的守护，让我…
尽骑士之责。
EN: No matter what you say, I won't leave. Please allow me to protect you...\nto fulfill my knightly oath.

CN: ……不要太靠近我的房间。瘟疫已经无法挽回，至少…不要让你们也染上。
EN: ...Then don't get too close to my room. The plague is irreversible, so at least... don't let it infect you as well.

CN:
水钟每流尽一次，就来和我说话，好吗？
等我不再回应的时候…你们就离开吧。
EN: Every time the water clock empties, come speak to me, alright?\nWhen I no longer respond... you should all leave.

CN:
能以肉眼观测融蚀现象的人，万中无一。
奥吉尔就是其中一个不幸的幸运儿。
EN: Those who can visually observe the Dissolution Phenomenon are extremely rare. Ogier is one of the unfortunate, yet fortunate, few.

CN: 和看不见的敌人作战还是头一遭，等这些事儿都结束了，咱们可以去找个吟游诗人把故事写下来，写成一首歌怎么样？
EN: It's my first time fighting invisible enemies. When all this is over, we should find a bard to turn the story into a song—how about that?

CN: 不过…瘟疫会化成怪物，普通人还没法看见？
EN: However... the plague takes the form of monsters that ordinary people cannot see?

CN: 真的太荒诞了，就算让宫廷诗人传唱，恐怕也没几人会信吧。
EN: It sounds truly absurd. Even if the court poets were to sing of it, few would likely believe it.

CN: 护卫骑士咳嗽了一下，混杂着肉块组织的鲜血从喉咙涌出。他难以置信地瞪大双眼，茫然又恐惧。
EN: The Guardian Knight coughs, blood mixed with tissue fragments gushing from his throat. His eyes widen in disbelief, filled with confusion and fear.

CN: 别用他的死苛责自己，那些@1怪物神出鬼没，我们已经尽力了。
EN: Don't blame yourself for this. Those @1 monsters strike without warning. We did all that we could.

CN:
奥吉尔摇摇头，你苍白的安慰显然没能安慰到他。
这时，身后传来了轻微的叩门声。
EN: Ogier shakes his head; your shallow comfort clearly failed to soothe him.\nJust then, a faint knock comes from behind.

CN: 公主难得离开房间，倚在二楼走廊的栏杆上，悠然地看着你们在大厅忙活，前来觐见的奥吉尔则紧张得都不知道该如何下脚。
EN: The princess left her room—a rare occurrence. She leaned against the railing of the second-floor corridor, leisurely watching the two of you bustle about in the hall below. Ogier, who had come for an audience, was so nervous he didn't know where to place his feet.

CN:
奥吉尔猛地把你一推，塞进了矮几之下。
你的视角天旋地转，最后只能看见华贵的波斯毯被火焰烧得卷了边。
EN: Ogier shoves you hard, pushing you under the low table.\nYour vision spins, and all you can see is the luxurious Persian rug curling at the edges due to the flames.

CN:
抵抗在绝对的力量悬殊前，是苍白的。
士官轻松地挑开奥吉尔的长枪，把一把匕首推进了他的胸口。
EN: Resistance is a fickle thing in the face of absolute power.\nThe sergeant effortlessly parries Ogier's spear, and with a casual flick of his wrist, drives a dagger deep into the boy's chest.

CN:
看到了吗？这才是你该学的技巧。
毕竟国家覆灭后，你们只配待在不见天日的黑街里。
EN: See? This is the kind of skill you should learn.\nAfter your nation falls, you'll only belong in the sunless back alleys.

CN: 鲜血涌进气管，带起了沉闷的痛苦，又像在陆地上溺了水，每次呼吸都喷呛着血的气息。
EN: Blood surges into his windpipe, creating a dull, suffocating agony, like drowning on land. Each breath chokes on the scent of blood.

CN:
你想冲出矮几，想把楼梯边的士官推下楼，想保护跪在门前的奥吉尔。
但这具身体却突然颤抖着、僵硬着，不再听你的使唤。
EN: You want to rush out from under the low table, to shove the sergeant down the stairs, to protect Ogier kneeling by the door.\nBut your body betrays you. Trembling, rigid, it refuses to obey.

CN:
小弟弟，看你这么执着的样子，不会在保护什么吧？
公主是不是就在门后面？
EN: Look at you, little one, so determined... Are you protecting someone? Is the princess behind this door?

CN:
诶呦——别这么残忍嘛。
这么折磨她的骑士，万一“女巫公主”诅咒了我们怎么办？
EN: Aww—don't be so cruel.\nWhat if the "Witch Princess" puts a curse on us for torturing her knight?

CN: <Small:不行……不要出…不……进……>
EN: <Small:No... don't come out... No... leave...>

CN: 和你链接的唤醒体，包括我，或多或少都感觉到了异常。
EN: Awakeners linked to you, including me, more or less sensed abnormalities.

CN:
你向朵尔描绘了荒诞梦境中的一切。
公主、骑士、瘟疫……
EN: You describe everything in the absurd dream to Doll.\nThe princess, the knights, the plague...

CN: 目前看来，这种“入梦”并没有对你造成进一步影响，我会继续密切监控你的精神波形。
EN: It seems that this "dream" hasn't resulted in any further effects. I'll keep monitoring your spirit waves closely.

CN: 被融蚀浆吞噬的感觉太过真实，清晨的阳光照在了被子上，本该感到融融暖意的身体却因此如坠冰窟。
EN: The feeling of being devoured by D-Slime was all too real. The morning sun shines on the blanket, but the warmth that should feel comforting now makes your body feel as if it is plunged into icy water.

CN:
弥萨格大学 训练场
清晨
EN: Mythag University Training Ground\nMorning

CN:
汉娜小姐再坚持一会儿，还有一圈就结束了。
这次体能测试您一定能顺利通过！
EN: Just a bit longer, Miss Hanna—one more lap and we're done.\nYou'll definitely pass the physical test this time!

CN: 主君，请容我拒绝。融蚀危机近在眼前，我……现在的我，还没做好准备。
EN: My lord, please allow me to refuse. The Dissolution crisis is imminent, and I... I'm not ready yet.

CN: 那个和他一起在骑士团度过的午后突然跳进了脑海，某些你以为会随着梦醒而被遗忘的记忆浮现。
EN: That afternoon spent with him in the Knights' Order suddenly appears in your mind. Memories you thought would fade with the dream resurface.

CN: 你故意念叨着行程安排，自顾自离开训练场，心中一点担忧都没有。
EN: You mutter your itinerary on purpose, striding off without a backward glance. You feel no worry at all.
